policy.primary_unit: unique folded protein; repeated pH/material conditions do not increase unique-protein count
policy.journal: publication-year Q1 target; journal-year quartile audited separately
policy.surface: real solid/material surface or nanoparticle interface
policy.ground_truth: experimental protein-side localization at residue, peptide, domain, or molecular-face level
excluded_as_primary_gt: protein-protein, peptide, nucleic-acid, or membrane-lipid interfaces
systems dominated by major adsorption-induced unfolding when the native-state patch is not interpretable

cases.evidence: limited proteolysis + mass spectrometry; Domain II faces silica
cases.journal: Journal of Colloid and Interface Science
cases.notes: Broad-domain ground truth; descriptive coarse-patch validation, not exact-residue validation.

cases.evidence: experimental peptide-level footprinting; UniProt peptide positions mapped to 2VUF numbering by -24
cases.notes: Peptide-level interface; numbering mapping is explicit.

cases.evidence: position-specific fluorescence/orientation experiment; residue-10 region significant at pH 6.3
cases.notes: Anchor-patch benchmark; exact construct differs from 2CBA proxy and is retained as a documented limitation.

cases.evidence: position-specific fluorescence/orientation experiment; residue-37 region becomes important at higher pH
cases.notes: Same protein as pH 6.3; counts as one unique protein.

cases.evidence: experimental Lys-to-Ala perturbation / nanoparticle binding measurements
cases.notes: K4/K13/K50 are the locked experimental anchor set used in the prior audit; bibliographic DOI should be frozen before manuscript export.

cases.evidence: mass-spectrometry accessibility mapping; decreased accessibility interpreted as blocked/contact region
cases.notes: 240-260 and N-terminal increases are not treated as contact GT because they reflect exposure/rearrangement.

cases.evidence: mass-spectrometry accessibility mapping; decreased accessibility regions on PS nanoparticles
cases.notes: Chains C+E represent one transferrin molecule in 1SUV; receptor chains are excluded. State/complex/resolution mismatch remains a limitation.

cases.evidence: experimental NMR/CSP-type regional localization on aluminum hydroxide adjuvant
cases.notes: Broad regional GT; native 3D structure retained in the experimental interpretation.

cases.evidence: NMR + proteomics-MS; common interaction face formed by the two alpha helices
cases.notes: Ranges are structural proxies for the two experimental helices and must be replaced by exact SI residue membership before final manuscript statistics.

cases.evidence: solution NMR localization; N-terminal tail + BC loop + DE loop form the preferential MPA-AuNP interaction region
cases.notes: Coarse loop-level GT intentionally matches V2's regional prediction scope.
